meta.design_system: Hermes Elite Minimalist Plugin Design System
meta.author: Nous Research & Antigravity AI
meta.philosophy: Living Single Source of Truth (SOT) for the entire Hermes desktop ecosystem. Serves as the authoritative visual styleguide, token dictionary, and component specification manual across all plugins.

sans.name: UI Primary Sans
sans.cssFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
sans.role: Primary interface typography for controls, navigation labels, descriptions, and conversational prose.

mono.name: Telemetry Monospace
mono.cssFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
mono.role: Precision technical data, container IDs, hashes, timestamps, memory stats, JSON payloads, and ports.

display.name: Display Header Sans
display.role: Cockpit titles, uppercase section headers, and prominent KPI ratio numbers.

kpi_hero.name: KPI Hero Counter
kpi_hero.usage: Prominent numerical readouts, active goal counts, budget metrics
kpi_hero.reference: Goal Judge KPI Hero Counters (Total Tracked: 24, Active: 1, Done: 11)

pane_title.name: Header Cockpit Title
pane_title.usage: Cockpit titles, top-level pane identity, session headlines

action_body.name: Primary Action & Body Prose
action_body.usage: Cockpit action buttons, goal objective prose, modal forms
action_body.reference: Goal Judge Primary Action Cockpit Buttons & Body Prose

section_label.name: SectionHeader Title & Form Labels
section_label.usage: SectionHeader uppercase titles, input labels, technical session IDs
section_label.reference: Goal Judge SectionHeader Titles & Form Field Labels

action_subtext.name: Action Subtext & Micro Chips
action_subtext.usage: Action button subtext, status badges, version chips, pill tags

components.action_cockpit: Single row, button top, text under
components.verdict_proof_banner: Single-shade elevation rgba(18, 20, 26, 0.78) with green/red 3px left solid border
components.turn_budget_gauge: Borderless track with dynamic color thresholds and looper controls (+10, +25, loop)
components.criteria_subgoals_drawer: Collapsible drawer with numbered criteria and inline edit/delete/add controls
components.steering_cockpit: Mid-turn prompt injection drawer with quick preset pills
components.filter_pills: Multi-category filter bar with persistent Codicon colors

invariants: Maximum 3 font families strictly enforced across the entire desktop app
Standard 380px pane width across all registered plugin panels
No boxes inside boxes on metadata cards
Explicit inline styles for all category icons, badges, and action buttons
Single-shade elevation (rgba(18, 20, 26, 0.78)) with 3px left vertical accents and negative space padding (18px/22px)
Action cockpit single horizontal row with button strictly on top and text underneath
Border disappearance & seamless elevation (Rule 07): layout containers use border-transparent without harsh bounding strokes or inset highlight lines
